title: Partner outreach + secured criteria + fallback dataset selection (runs in parallel)
context: The project's central honest gap is that no partner citizen-science project is yet secured; until one adopts the toolkit on a real dataset this is infrastructure, not a delivered deed. This long-lead outreach task runs in parallel from M0 and records the objective criteria a partner must meet to be counted as secured. It also selects an openly-licensed public fallback dataset so the loop can be exercised without a partner. No real partner data is processed.
objective: Produce an outreach + secured-criteria document that records the objective definition of a secured partner, identifies at least one candidate partner category and opens at least one outreach thread, and selects an openly-licensed public fallback dataset.
acceptanceCriteria: Records the objective secured criteria: signed data-use agreement + named accountable contact + passing acceptance test
Identifies at least one candidate partner category and opens at least one outreach thread
Selects an openly-licensed public fallback dataset (e.g. a CC0 GBIF subset) for the no-partner path
Keeps partner status as TO BE SECURED and verifiedNeed false until all three secured criteria hold
output: docs/partner/outreach-and-secured-criteria.md recording secured criteria, candidate categories, outreach status, and the selected openly-licensed fallback dataset.
